entries.question: Which channels do you support
entries.answer: Instagram, Facebook, LINE and TikTok comments and direct messages, all through one policy layer.

entries.question: How long does onboarding take
entries.answer: Three to five working days: channel access on day one, knowledge base and reply rules on day two, shadow mode on day three.

entries.question: How is it priced
entries.answer: A monthly plan based on the number of channels and message volume. A range is confirmed after we see account count and volume.

entries.question: Do you need my password
entries.answer: No. Only official platform authorization is used, and access can be revoked from the platform at any time.

entries.question: What if the AI answers wrong
entries.answer: When confidence is low or a sensitive topic appears, the message goes to a human queue instead of being answered.

entries.question: Does it answer direct messages too
entries.answer: Yes. Comments and direct messages share one pipeline; platform reply windows apply and timeouts escalate to a human.
